claims.text: HDFC Bank operates in three business verticals - Wholesale, Retail and Treasury, and all its products and services are offered under these segments.
The annual report lists Total Banking Outlets of 23,920 and Total Branches of 8,738 (inclusive of Overseas Branches and DBUs), of which 52% are SURU branches.

On the Q4 FY2024-25 call, Sashidhar Jagdishan said that for FY '26 the company expects GDP to be supported by a pickup in rural spending, discretionary consumer demand and investment activity, while goods exports may be impacted until the global trade and tariff situation becomes clearer.
claims.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

claims.text: On the Q4 FY2024-25 call, Srinivasan Vaidyanathan said that loans linked to policy rates like the repo rate reprice right away, which is a headwind, while deposit rates take time to adjust. He declined to give a margin outlook and urged not to look at it quarter-to-quarter.
claims.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan

claims.text: On the Q4 FY2024-25 call, Srinivasan Vaidyanathan said the loan-to-deposit ratio (LDR) is expected to come back into the premerger 85 to 90 range in FY '27. He said that in FY '26, subject to appropriate pricing, with quality always given, the bank would grow at the market rate of growth.
claims.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
